needsBespoke.why: The kit is expressible with standard primitives: an onhit true-damage rider with crit interaction (P), a plain-cast AoE nuke (Q), ticking DoT zones (W, E), a stacking target debuff (E), a channel that can be interrupted by another ability (E during W), and an ammo/recharge system with an nth-cast empowered shot and attack-triggered cooldown reduction (R). No unique mechanic here (e.g. stance switching, pet AI, self-damage) falls outside this list.

unsettled.question: How should R's cast rate be modeled: as a flat 2s cooldown per cast (bin's 'cooldown' array), or as gated by a separate 20s-per-charge 'recharge' pool shown only on the wiki, with ammo capped at 4?
options: R can be cast every 2s as long as ammo (max 4) is available, and ammo separately refills on a ~20s-per-charge timer independent of the 2s cast cooldown
The bin's cooldown=2 IS the effective per-charge recharge timer and the wiki's 'recharge=20' is stale/unrelated, so R effectively refills one charge every 2s
quotes: '''Corki''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Missile Barrage'' charge, up to a maximum of 4.

Assume all 3 patches overlap the dummy (Corki dashes through/around it at max range), tripling W's total damage per cast to up to 15 ticks

unsettled.question: If a target would die from Hextech Munitions' on-hit (physical) portion of an attack, the true-damage portion is described as a bug that gets skipped; should the damage-fight simulator honor this order-dependent bug for kill-time ranking against a target dummy?
options: Model the bug: true damage instance is skipped if the target would already be dead from on-hit/physical damage in the same attack
Ignore the bug as unintended and always apply both damage instances in full for simulation purposes
quotes: If the target dies from {{tip|on-hit}} damage, the true damage portion will be skipped and only the physical damage applied.{{bug}}

proposal: Assume Corki enters the fight with full Missile Barrage ammo (4 charges) and starts within range of the dummy.
Open by firing Q (Phosphorus Bomb) at the dummy for the initial magic-damage poke.
Immediately begin firing R (Missile Barrage) charges roughly every 2 seconds, consuming all stored ammo (every 3rd shot is a Big One) while it recharges over the fight.
Cast W (Valkyrie) toward/through the dummy so its fire patches land on the target, casting E (Gatling Gun) during the W dash to stack both DoTs simultaneously.
Auto-attack the dummy continuously between ability casts to trigger Hextech Munitions' bonus true damage and to chip R's recharge via on-hit reduction.
Recast E on cooldown (every 12s) whenever facing the dummy, letting its 4-second channel run uninterrupted except for weaving R casts.
Recast Q on cooldown (~7-9s at low rank) and W on cooldown (~12-20s) as they come off cooldown, prioritizing whichever keeps mana available for continued R and E use.
Maintain auto-attacks as the default action whenever no ability is off cooldown, to keep the true-damage rider and R recharge reduction active for the full 15 seconds.
questions: Does the simulated dummy fight assume Corki starts with 4 stocked R charges (as if just spawned) or only the 2 granted on first learning R?
Should Gatling Gun's 4-second channel be treated as uninterruptible (blocking Q/W/R casts) for the full duration, or can other spells be freely woven in mid-channel alongside it?
For Valkyrie, should the dummy be assumed stationary directly under Corki's dash path so all 3 fire patches land on it, or should a more conservative single-patch assumption be used?
Is crit chance assumed to be zero, partial, or itemized in the build being simulated, since it directly scales R's cooldown-reduction-on-hit value?
